policy: No test over test_seconds and no file over file_seconds (setup+call+teardown, from the verification runner). Exempt: the acceptance journeys (al/TESTS.md) and the few named tests in 'exempt', each with the reason it must spawn real processes.

exempt.installer:al/tests/test_verification_har: runs the sealed recipe child twice in real interpreters to prove import isolation
exempt.installer:al/tests/test_workspace_harnes: builds and installs the real Harness wheel with uv
exempt.installer:al/tests/test_verify_changed.p: drives the real verification runner (collection plus parallel pytest children)
drives the real verification runner (collection plus split pytest children)

acceptance_reasons.*:tests/test_runtime_batch6.py::test_cha: changed rule source: resume/retry replan, fresh review, approval
acceptance_reasons.*:tests/test_rework_recovery.py::test_si: rework credits: automatic grants, Architect decisions, precise cap
acceptance_reasons.*:tests/test_rework_recovery.py::test_ge: corrections between recovered batches never mint rework credit
